name: Mercari
summary: Mercari's careers site describes document screening, a technical assessment for some positions (often a take-home coding assignment of about a week), several interviews and an offer meeting with reference checks. It says interviews look at your enthusiasm for Mercari's mission, how you embody its values (Go Bold, All for One and Be a Pro) and culture fit. Candidates commonly report a manager interview and a final round with someone senior; Mercari India's engineering hiring has used online coding tests.
rounds: Document screening: your CV and what you'd like to do at Mercari
Technical assessment for some positions: a take-home assignment or online coding test
Interviews with the team and a manager, often 30 to 60 minutes each
Final interview, often with a senior leader

questions.text: Tell me about the boldest thing you've tried at work. What happened?
covers: What you tried and why it was bold
The result, even if it failed

questions.text: Tell me about a time you put the team's goal ahead of your own work.
covers: What it achieved for the team

questions.text: Tell me about something you became an expert in. How did you get there?
covers: The skill and why it mattered

questions.text: Tell me about a time you shipped something quickly and improved it later.
covers: The first version and its limits
What you improved and how you knew

questions.text: How would you design a marketplace feature that suggests a price when someone lists an item?
covers: Data: similar items, condition, recent sales
A simple first version and how it learns

questions.text: How would you stop scams between buyers and sellers on a marketplace?
covers: Holding payment until delivery, checks and reports
Balancing safety with a smooth experience

questions.text: Walk me through the take-home: what trade-offs did you make, and what would you change with more time?
How would you make a mobile app's listing flow faster for first-time sellers?
covers: Ideas such as photo-first listing and smart defaults
A test and the metric to watch

questions.text: Given a list of item prices, how would you find two that add up to a target amount?
covers: A simple approach and its cost
A faster approach with a hash map

questions.text: Which of Mercari's values do you relate to most, with an example?
Why do you want to work at Mercari?
covers: What draws you to Mercari's mission of circulating value
How your skills fit the team

questions.text: What would you want to accomplish in your first year?
covers: A goal tied to the role

tips: Prepare a STAR story for each of Mercari's values: Go Bold, All for One and Be a Pro.
In your documents, summarise past work, your role and results, and what you want to do at Mercari, as its careers site suggests.
For engineering, practise data structures and algorithms; some teams give a take-home of about a week.
Ask your recruiter or interviewer about the exact steps for your role; Mercari says they vary.
